title: Refusal Is Not Robustness: Measuring Harmful Reachability in Autoregressive Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.22754v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM safety evaluations via jailbreaking typically index on attack success rate (ASR): whether a generated response violates safeguards. However, ASR only evaluates sampled outputs and provides little information on the underlying generation process. Autoregressive language models define distributions over possible outputs, and a sampled refusal can coexist with substantial probability mass on harmful generation paths. We study this hidden structure through bounded continuation analysis (BCA), which models autoregressive generation as a stochastic process over token prefixes and computes the finite-horizon probability that generation reaches a harmful continuation. BCA constructs a bounded continuation tree, labels terminal continuations with a semantic harm evaluator, and estimates harmful reachability using exact probabilistic model checking. translated_title: 拒答并非鲁棒性：度量自回归语言模型中的有害可达性
translated_abstract: 通过越狱攻击对大语言模型（LLM）进行安全评估通常以攻击成功率（ASR）为指标：即生成的回复是否违反了安全防护。然而，ASR 仅评估采样得到的输出，对底层生成过程几乎不提供任何信息。自回归语言模型在可能的输出上定义了一个分布，一次采样得到的拒答可能与有害生成路径上存在的大量概率质量同时共存。我们通过有界延续分析（Bounded Continuation Analysis, BCA）来研究这种隐藏结构，该方法将自回归生成建模为在词元前缀上的随机过程，并计算生成过程在有限步内到达有害延续内容的概率。BCA 构建一棵有界延续树，用语义危害评估器对终端延续进行标注，并利用精确的概率模型检测来估计有害可达性。BCA 对 ASR 形成补充，它度量了在一次采样得到的拒答之下，仍有多少有害行为是可以到达的。
tldr: 该论文提出有界延续分析（BCA），将自回归生成建模为随机过程并借助精确概率模型检测，量化了模型在采样出拒答的表面下仍能到达有害内容的概率（有害可达性），弥补了仅用攻击成功率评估 LLM 安全性的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Bounded Continuation Analysis (BCA), which models autoregressive generation as a stochastic process and uses exact probabilistic model checking to quantify how much harmful content remains reachable beneath sampled refusals, complementing attack success rate (ASR) based LLM safety evaluation.
